bullets.text: Debt to the Penny (22 Sep 2026): TPDO ~$40.10T; debt held by the public ~$32.38T; intragovernmental ~$7.72T. Never swap stocks.
CBO Outlook: debt held by the public ~101% of GDP (2026) → ~120% (2036); deficits and rising net interest under current law (not a clean inflate-away reset).
TIC Table 5: foreign official Treasury holdings ~$3,773.1B at end-Jul 2026 (watch item — do not claim dumping without a dated move).
IMF COFER: USD share ~57.13% of allocated FX reserves, 2026Q1 (provisional). Dollar remains largest; share moves over time — watch, not crash claim.
MSPD 31 Aug 2026: TIPS outstanding ~$2.15T; FRNs ~$0.68T (limits pure inflate-away across the whole book).
GENIUS Act (payment stablecoins), Public Law 119-27, enacted 18 Jul 2025 — payment-rail concentration / control statute (not a CBDC essay).
Closer bridge: fixed-coupon debt can lighten in real terms after inflation; that is not a clean fiscal reset when markets reprice yields and public debt still climbs vs GDP on the CBO path.
